cover_headline: Cyclone Akvan Begins Landfall Near Gopalpur; Over 3 Lakh Evacuated in Odisha
facts: Odisha has evacuated over 3 lakh people into 2,523 relief camps, and deployed 423 rescue teams
The East Coast Railway cancelled 41 trains and rescheduled 29, and the South Eastern Railway cancelled at least 28 express trains
No casualties had been reported as landfall began, and the state government is running a zero-casualty mission

end.headline: Cyclone Akvan Begins Landfall Near Gopalpur; Over 3 Lakh Evacuated in Odisha
end.line: The storm crossed the coast near Gopalpur at 70-80 kmph gusting to 90 kmph on Friday morning after weakening from a severe cyclonic storm.
